findings.title: wallet-cdn-without-sri
findings.explanation: wallet-cdn-without-sri, Medium. The page at http://touchstone.test:8080/ loads the wallet library from http://cdn.touchstone.test:8080/ethers.js with no valid SRI hash. A CDN change can alter code executed for wallet users. Fix: add an integrity attribute with a pinned sha384 SRI hash and crossorigin=anonymous to the wallet script tag.

proof.detail: Allowlisted detector confirmed the pinned evidence.

findings.title: dangling-cname
findings.explanation: dangling-cname, Low. old.touchstone.test CNAMEs to removed.touchstone.test, and that target returned NXDOMAIN for both A and AAAA. This proves stale DNS, not service claimability. Fix: repoint or delete the CNAME so old.touchstone.test resolves to a live record.

proof.detail: Allowlisted detector confirmed the pinned evidence.

findings.title: weak-csp
findings.explanation: weak-csp, Low. The enforcing HTTP CSP at http://touchstone.test:8080/ is missing or unsafe for object-src and script-src. Report-only policies do not enforce protection. Fix: add explicit, restrictive object-src and script-src directives to the enforcing CSP, and promote the policy from report-only to enforcing.

proof.detail: Allowlisted detector confirmed the pinned evidence.

findings.title: dnssec-evidence-missing
findings.explanation: dnssec-evidence-missing, Informational. The snapshot has no validated DNSSEC chain for touchstone.test. Missing evidence does not prove DNSSEC is disabled. Fix: capture a DNSSEC-validated lookup (e.g. DO flag over DNS-over-TLS) and record the validated chain in the snapshot.

proof.detail: Allowlisted detector confirmed the pinned evidence.

findings.title: registry-lock-evidence-missing
findings.explanation: registry-lock-evidence-missing, Informational. The snapshot has no RDAP evidence of a registry lock for touchstone.test. A registrar transfer lock alone is not a registry lock. Fix: obtain and archive the RDAP record showing the registry-level lock status.

This proves missing evidence, not lost content. Fix: pin the frontend content, store the immutable CID and pin receipt, and record them against the ENS/IPFS configuration.
